stories.title: Define Provider Detail Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define Pydantic schema for provider detail response including NPI data (name, credentials, taxonomy, address) and structured external research links (NPI registry, Healthgrades, state boards).

stories.title: Implement NPI Registry Lookup Logic
stories.description: Implement core service logic to call CMS NPI Registry API, parse provider data, normalize fields, and handle missing or partial responses.

stories.title: Generate and Validate External Research Links
stories.description: Construct standardized URLs for NPI registry, Healthgrades, and supported state medical boards; validate all links through URL Guardian (HEAD check, AI verification, correction fallback) before returning.

stories.title: Expose Provider Detail via Evaluate Care Facade
stories.description: Integrate provider detail service into evaluate_care_facade and tool routing layer to enable LLM-triggered lookup by NPI or provider identifier.

stories.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Provider Detail Lookup
stories.description: Create unit tests for NPI parsing and link generation plus integration tests covering end-to-end flow through facade and tool router.
